blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Cebu’s three highly urbanized cities posted higher inflation rates in September 2026, according to the latest data from the Philippine Statistics Authority in Central Visayas (PSA-7). Cebu City recorded the highest rate at 8.4 percent in September, up from 7.5 percent in August and 3.1 percent in September 2025. Mandaue City […]...
